recap.text:
Newport Select Gold 14U Edge Past Tides Select White
November 21, 2026 vs. Tides Select White
Newport Select Gold 14U squeaked past Tides Select White, 40-36, on Saturday at Snoqualmie Middle School.
Aiden Ng scored 11 points to lead Newport Select Gold 14U.
Newport Select Gold 14U got out to a 17-13 lead at halftime before closing out the victory.
Newport Select Gold 14U controlled the first half, outscoring Tides Select White 17-13.
Kalden Sen made three of 10 free throws, and Newport Select Gold 14U attempted 33. Sen pounded the glass, collecting seven rebounds to lead Newport Select Gold 14U. Additional scorers for Newport Select Gold 14U included Sen (9 points), Talen Tep (5 points), Deacon Chun (5 points), Uttam Verriach (4 points), Mason Huang (2 points), Harry Zhang (2 points), and Charles (2 points).
Tides Select White shot well from distance, going 4-6 from three.
Newport Select Gold 14U play at home on Saturday against Sumner in their next game.
